const r = await tools.exec_command({
  cmd: "PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -B -c '
import json
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
root=Path.cwd()
task=root/".ai/task/repair-w68-20261012"
files=["mod-tome.lua","tome-ashes-urhrok.lua","tome-cults.lua","tome-orcs.lua"]
loader=LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(load_manifest()))
workset=json.loads((task/"WORKSET.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["items"]
new_targets=json.loads((task/"NEW-TARGETS.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
adjudication=json.loads((task/"ADJUDICATION-R0.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
fixes={x["revision_key"]:tuple(x["fix"]) for x in adjudication["findings"] if x["status"]=="confirmed"}
changed=[]
current_by_file={}
baseline_by_file={}
for file in files:
    base=loader.load_path(task/"baseline"/file, logical_path=file)
    cur=loader.load_path(root/file, logical_path=file)
    assert len(base.records)==len(cur.records), (file,len(base.records),len(cur.records))
    current_by_file[file]=cur.translations
    baseline_by_file[file]=base.translations
    for index,(before,after) in enumerate(zip(base.records,cur.records)):
        b=dict(before); a=dict(after)
        bt=b.pop("target",None); at=a.pop("target",None)
        assert b==a, (file,index,"non-target record changed",b,a)
        if bt!=at:
            changed.append((file,index,bt,at))
assert len(changed)==106, len(changed)
assert Counter(x[0] for x in changed)==Counter({"mod-tome.lua":78,"tome-ashes-urhrok.lua":7,"tome-cults.lua":11,"tome-orcs.lua":10})
seen=set(); r0_delta=[]
for item in workset:
    rev=item["entry_revision_identity"]
    file=item["normalized_path"]
    def matches(rec):
        return rec["section"]==item["section"] and rec["source"]==item["source"] and rec.get("source_tag")==item.get("source_tag") and rec.get("args_order")==item.get("args_order")
    base_hits=[r for r in baseline_by_file[file] if matches(r)]
    cur_hits=[r for r in current_by_file[file] if matches(r)]
    assert len(base_hits)==len(cur_hits)==1, (rev,len(base_hits),len(cur_hits))
    assert base_hits[0]["target"]==item["target_preimage"]==new_targets[rev]["old_target"], rev
    expected=new_targets[rev]["new_target"]
    if rev in fixes:
        old,new=fixes[rev]
        assert expected.count(old)==1, (rev,"fix preimage count",expected.count(old))
        expected=expected.replace(old,new,1)
        r0_delta.append(rev)
    assert cur_hits[0]["target"]==expected, rev
    seen.add((file,cur_hits[0]["line"],cur_hits[0]["source"],cur_hits[0].get("source_tag")))
assert len(seen)==106
assert sorted(r0_delta)==sorted(fixes) and len(fixes)==2
print("PASS LuaJIT semantic load: 4/4 files")
print("PASS baseline target changes: 106 (mod-tome.lua=78, tome-ashes-urhrok.lua=7, tome-cults.lua=11, tome-orcs.lua=10)")
print("PASS frozen targets exact after adjudication: 106/106; non-target records unchanged")
print("PASS R0 delta: 2/2 only (616edb9a50, aef0a389a1)")
' ",
  workdir: "/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",
  yield_time_ms: 30000,
  max_output_tokens: 20000
}); text(r.output);
